final: SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) / (SELECT AVG(regional_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t2.amount WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t2.amount END) AS regional_avg FROM trans t2 JOIN account a2 ON t2.account_id = a2.account_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE t2.date > '1996-05-09' AND t2.date < '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d2.A3)) AS ratio_to_overall_regional_average FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date > '1996-05-09' AND t.date < '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3 HAVING (SELECT AVG(regional_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t2.amount WHEN t2.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t2.amount END) AS regional_avg FROM trans t2 JOIN account a2 ON t2.account_id = a2.account_id JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE t2.date > '1996-05-09' AND t2.date < '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d2.A3)) IS NOT NULL
